Hi Sara / Tom,

Great to hear LumenHealth is ready to lock in the renewal/expansion QBR — thanks. We want to combine the renewal briefing with a focused roadmap demo that covers the new batching/quantization recommendations and the Dedicated capacity proposal. To make scheduling smooth across teams, proposed windows below (all in PDT):

- Option A: Wed Aug 13, 10:00–11:00 (90% live-demo, 10% pricing/next steps)
- Option B: Thu Aug 14, 08:00–09:00 (earlier slot for east-coast execs)
- Option C: Fri Aug 15, 13:00–14:00 (backup technical deep-dive)

A few asks from our side:
- Please confirm which window works best and whether you want the session recorded for internal distribution.
- If procurement needs to be on the call for contract questions, loop them in — I cc'ed Tom in case he wants procurement on the thread.

Attached: pre-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda + 15-minute pre-read) and a short technical checklist we can run before the demo.

If none of these work, tell us two 1-hour windows next week and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks — Evelyn
